title: Fireworks AI API key: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: FW_ vs the documented lowercase fw_ (provider code's startsWith check is case-sensitive), prefix namespace: fv_ vs the documented fw_ (one-letter deviation; neither fw_ nor fpk_), and prefix namespace: wf_ vs the documented fw_ (transposed; neither fw_ nor fpk_). Twin of "Fireworks AI API key: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of fireworks-ai-api-key-bearer-curl: prefix namespace: fv_ vs the documented fw_ (one-letter deviation; neither fw_ nor fpk_). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
